address: 86-88 Thapae Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand
bio: Meaning ‘come’ in the Southern language, ‘Maadae’ invites you to enjoy delightful seafood in a welcoming atmosphere. Supporting local Chumphon fishermen and sourcing seasonal organic produce, their menu rotates with fresh ingredients. The evening selection offers diverse options, including superb freshly grilled seafood paired with a spicy sauce....
